aboutPreview.title: REC Pilar
aboutPreview.text: Discover our modern recording studio, equipped with cutting-edge technology to bring life to your creative ideas. From music to audiovisual productions, we offer an inspiring space for artists and professionals.

donation.ctaText: Every contribution, big or small, directly supports the programs, the property and the studio to serve the community.
